title: Kieli
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Eighty years after a war in which immortal soldiers called the Undying, made from battlefield corpses, were wiped out 'in the name of God' by those they served, orphaned 14-year-old Kieli, who can see ghosts, doubts that God exists (Yen Press blurbs via AniList and MangaUpdates). She meets Harvey, an Undying, and his possessed radio, and travels with him, which forces her to rethink the meaning of faith. A two-volume manga adaptation of a light novel, listed as cut short.
life_message: It suggests that real compassion matters more than religious hypocrisy, and that faith must be examined honestly.

content.note: Backstory of a bloody war and extermination; Harvey is hunted (blurb; MangaUpdates Hunted Protagonist).
Ghosts, undead and a dark atmosphere (MangaUpdates Ghost/s, Undead, Dark Ambience; AniList Ghost).
Subtle romance between 14-year-old Kieli and an ageless undead man; non-sexual per tags (MangaUpdates Subtle Romance, Older Male Younger Female; to verify).
Loneliness, orphanhood and trauma (MangaUpdates Loneliness, Traumatic Past).
A young girl leaves to travel with a stranger (blurb).
